title: Gate and contain a vLLM rollout
description: Select a change, isolate or share the rollout pool, choose canary traffic, collect evidence, and inject a failure to see the expected blast radius and response.

changes.label: Engine upgrade
changes.detail: Runtime, kernel, scheduler, dependency, and metric behavior may move together.

changes.label: Parallelism change
changes.detail: Process placement and collectives change replica latency and failure scope.

changes.label: Model and runtime bundle
changes.detail: Model outputs, tokenizer behavior, parsers, memory, and performance all need comparison.

topologies.label: Separate canary pool
topologies.detail: The candidate has independent workers, queue, KV state, and rollback routing.

topologies.label: In-place shared pool
topologies.detail: Candidate and reference capacity share the same serving failure domain.

gates.label: API contract
gates.detail: Streaming, non-streaming, errors, tool calls, and structured outputs match the product contract.

gates.label: Quality and safety
gates.detail: Task slices, refusals, safety checks, and parser outputs meet the reference floor.

gates.label: Representative load
gates.detail: Prompt, output, arrival, cancellation, and prefix distributions meet latency and goodput targets.

gates.label: Observability mapping
gates.detail: Dashboards and alerts use metrics present in the candidate release.

gates.label: Failure drill
gates.detail: A worker or collective failure stays inside the intended replica and routing recovers.

gates.label: Warm rollback
gates.detail: The reference pool restores capacity before the error budget is exhausted.

failures.label: No injected failure
failures.detail: Evaluate evidence and rollout shape before applying traffic.
failures.containment: Keep the candidate bounded until every required gate passes.

failures.label: KV exhaustion
failures.detail: Long live sequences consume the candidate's stable KV envelope.
failures.signal: KV usage, preemption, queue time, and tail latency rise together.
failures.containment: Stop candidate admission, drain or terminate the pool, then lower context or concurrency before retrying.

failures.label: API regression
failures.detail: The candidate changes a required response or streaming shape.
failures.signal: Contract checks and client parse errors fail only on the candidate route.
failures.containment: Set candidate traffic to zero and preserve failing payloads for versioned contract tests.

failures.label: Collective stall
failures.detail: One tensor or pipeline worker blocks the entire distributed replica.
failures.signal: Replica heartbeats fail while queue and collective latency increase.
failures.containment: Eject the complete replica group; never route around one missing rank inside that group.

failures.label: Metric contract drift
failures.detail: A release removes or renames a signal used by dashboards or alerts.
failures.signal: Release checks report missing metric families before user latency changes.
failures.containment: Block promotion and migrate recording rules against the candidate metrics endpoint.
